svg.title: Spectra setup: starting project, installation, discovery and configuration
svg.desc: Choose init for a new project or adopt for an existing codebase. Both install the Spectra layer; adopt additionally creates discovery evidence. Git mode changes tracking policy. Adapters are generated only when requested. Matching explanation groups S1 to S4 describe the paths and preservation rules.
